finding.message: src/presentation/server.ts (presentation) skips layers to import src/persistence/temperatureRepository.ts (persistence)

answer.explanation: src/presentation/server.ts is the process entry point and acts as the composition root. At line 10 it imports TemperatureRepository from the persistence layer. At line 45 it creates an instance and passes it straight into the IceMonitorService constructor from the business layer. The file never calls the repository itself. It only wires the object into the service that uses it. The same file follows this pattern for every other persistence class (lines 1–4, 6, 9, 18–29, 41–44). FF-S03 flags this because the presentation layer reaches past the business layer to depend directly on a persistence module, which breaks strict layering. The graph only shows a presentation→persistence edge and cannot tell wiring apart from data access. The code shows this is a construction-only dependency. The project provides no documentation, ADR or comment that names server.ts as a composition root allowed to skip layers.
